blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – Veteran journalist and mentor Allen V. del Carmen was honored with the MassKara Legacy Award for his decades of “writing, teaching, mentorship, and service to journalism.” Having mentored hundreds of journalists across various universities, newsrooms, and writing workshops, his work has helped shape the character of reporting in Western Visayas and Negros Island. READ: MassKara Fest draws huge crowds in Bacolod Del Carmen was also recognized as a pioneer of The Visayan Daily Star, Today’s News and Views (the forerunner of SunStar-Bacolod), Negros Weekly Magazine and Negros Now Daily, and for his contributions to sports journalism. “To many […]...
